newsitem.title: CHINA: China aquatic products output seen up in Jan-May.
newsitem.headline: China aquatic products output seen up in Jan-May.

text.p: China produced 9.12 million tonnes of aquatic products in the first five months, up 11.3 percent or 930,000 tonnes compared with the same period last year, the Xinhua news agency said on Tuesday.
Imports of aquatic products in the period were 730,000 tonnes valued at $580 million, it said.
Exports in January-May were 310,000 tonnes, up 11 percent year-on-year, though export value fell 24 percent year-on-year, it said without giving a figure for export value.
